messages:
tay: Quick thread — ACME asked for an envelope that makes billing and parsing simpler.

mina: TLDR: top-level token_count, snake_case response fields, optional enterprise token_usage object.

arthur: Strong preference: always return trace_id on every response + response_generated_at (ISO8601).

kai: For backward compatibility accept camelCase for 90 days for incoming requests, but responses should be canonical snake_case.

tay: Fallback rule: if structured output unsupported -> response.raw_text populated, response.fallback_reason = "struct_not_supported" and compatibility_code set.

mina: token_usage schema (enterprise only): prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, context_tokens. Only integers, no text.

arthur: Runtime perf note: token_count enabled by default, token_usage gated behind a flag to avoid overhead.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for schema-compact -> us-east at 18:00 UTC. Running smoke tests: envelope fields, token_count, trace_id.

kai: Action items: mina draft PR w/ examples, arthur add trace propagation tests, tay own compatibility_code doc and rollout plan.

tay: Ok closing — we'll reconvene after PR review. :thumbsup:
